snippet.title: Tattoo Shop Simulator – Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Tattoo Shop Simulator is a simulation game where you run your own tattoo studio.

Design tattoos, serve clients, customize your shop, unlock new skills, explore the city, and grow your business step by step. From a small tattoo shop to a recognizable brand — your reputation is everything.

👉 Wishlist now on Steam:
https://cutt.ly/7tnfqa4i

#TattooShopSimulator #SimulationGame #IndieGame #Steam #GameTrailer
